speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Posterior Hip Dislocation.

The clinical presentation of immediate onset of right groin pain following a rear-end collision, combined with the specific positioning you described (likely shortened and internally rotated, though you initially mentioned external), is classic for a posterior hip dislocation. The pelvic X-ray I requested confirms the femoral head is displaced posteriorly out of the acetabulum. This is a surgical emergency requiring immediate reduction to prevent avascular necrosis of the femoral head.
